features

Your personal context layer.

Find anything you ever said, see how your relationships move, and bring your favorite AI app to your own data. Most of it works with no model at all.

Chat

Claude embedded in the app

Claude lives inside Retrace and sees only what you allow. Use labels to give it access to the conversations that matter for your analysis. Ask about patterns, reflect on relationships, explore decisions. Your existing Claude subscription via the Agent SDK. No API key.

YouWhat idea have I kept coming back to?
get_topic_timeline(days=90)semantic_search("keep returning excited")
ClaudeOne thread runs through 23 conversations across three months: building something of your own. It shows up in a ChatGPT session in January, three WhatsApp messages in February, and six Claude conversations in March. Each time the tone is the same: energized, specific, a little scared.
Search · no model needed

Find anything you ever said

Search by meaning, not just keywords. "That restaurant someone recommended last summer" works. Semantic embeddings power similarity search across all platforms in one query.

restaurant recommendation last summer
WhatsAppSarah · Jul 2025"You have to try Maison Plisson, it's exactly your vibe"
ChatGPTParis trip planning · Aug 2025"Based on your preferences, I'd recommend these restaurants in the 3rd..."
MessengerTom · Aug 2025"We ended up at that place Sarah mentioned, it was incredible"
Network · no model needed

See your social graph

Force-directed visualization of your relationships. Tie-strength scoring reveals your inner circle. Timelapse animation shows connections forming over months. Dunbar-inspired tiers from inner circle to periphery.

Inner circle Active Extended
Capsules

This time last year

Rediscover what you were thinking, feeling, and doing a year ago. AI-powered then-and-now comparisons surface what's changed, what echoes, and what you forgot entirely. Reflections grounded in your actual conversations.

Then · April 2025

"Thinking about leaving my job but scared to take the leap. Talked to Sarah about it three times this month."

Now · April 2026

"Six months into the new role. The fear is gone. Conversations shifted from doubt to planning."

Rivers

Watch your life flow

Streamgraph visualization of conversations over time, colored by person or topic. See where your attention goes and how it shifts. Discover patterns in who you talk to and what you talk about.

Career Health Relationships
Scope

Labels and permissions

Tag conversations with labels. Set allow/block rules per consumer. Your private conversations stay private, even from your own agents. Platform labels are automatic. Topic labels are extracted by AI. Custom labels are yours.

Embedded Intelligence

Ask anything about your life.
Claude already has the context.

"What was I obsessing about last March?" "Who introduced me to that idea?" Claude is embedded via the Agent SDK. You choose what it can see using labels and permission rules. Explore your own history or reflect on it. Your existing Claude subscription. No API key. No per-token cost.

execute_queryflexible SQL over your data
semantic_searchvector similarity across all platforms

Coming soon

Your context layer, anywhere.

The phone is not where you manage data. It is where Retrace sends you something prepared, and you respond to it. Fully offline. No server needed.

Checkup

Contextualized prompts that know your life. Not "how are you feeling?" but "you told ChatGPT you were burned out, told Sarah you are fine, and your journal says nothing. What is actually going on?"

Digest

Your week, pre-written. Activity by platform, topic trends, relationship activity, emotional arc, key facts. The weekly review that writes itself.

Rediscovery

Forgotten stories from your own life, surfaced with evidence. Dropped threads, decisions you forgot making, patterns you lived through but never named.

Search

Your memory, queryable offline. Find that restaurant recommendation, that decision rationale, that thing someone said three weeks ago.

Desktop generates everything. Google Drive syncs it. Phone reads offline. No custom server. No accounts.
